The bus card machine is not far from my home. Jack and Ben are in the same class. Jack wants to visit Rome. Best of all, the old teacher is deaf in one ear.
After school, we play together. Ben often helps me with science. The library desk is big and clean. The little boy is feeding the ducks by the lake.
Jack drinks tea every morning. I am happy every day. I like my life very much.
